about.datasetCredit.source: Recommendation tags and similar titles in part from the Portico Title Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0), built from Wikipedia and Wikidata.

about.legal.text: 使用條款與隱私權政策：getportico.tv/terms 與 getportico.tv/privacy。中繼資料與圖片由 TMDB 及伺服器設定的其他提供者提供。
about.legal.source: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: getportico.tv/terms and getportico.tv/privacy. Metadata and artwork are provided by TMDB and other providers configured on your server.

about.report.afterCrash.text: Portico 上次意外關閉，報告將包含錯誤內容。
about.report.afterCrash.source: Portico closed unexpectedly last time. A report would include what went wrong.

about.report.confirmBody.text: 其中包含出錯時此應用程式記錄的內容，可能包括標題與此裝置的名稱，絕不包含密碼或登入資料。
about.report.confirmBody.source: It holds what this app logged while something went wrong. That can include the names of titles and of this device. It never includes your password or sign-in.

about.report.confirmTitle.text: 要將報告傳送給 {server} 的擁有者嗎？
about.report.confirmTitle.source: Send a report to the owner of {server}?

about.report.failed.text: 無法傳送報告，請稍後再試。
about.report.failed.source: The report couldn’t be sent. Try again later.

about.report.help.text: 將此應用程式最近的警告與錯誤傳送給 {server} 的擁有者，以協助找出問題。
about.report.help.source: Sends this app’s recent warnings and errors to the owner of {server}, to help find a problem.

about.report.sent.text: 報告已傳送給 {server} 的擁有者。
about.report.sent.source: The report was sent to the owner of {server}.

account.delete.affects.text: {servers} 上的個人檔案也會一併移除。
account.delete.affects.source: Your profiles on {servers} are removed too.

account.delete.changed.text: 開啟此頁後內容已有變更，請重新確認後再刪除。
account.delete.changed.source: Something changed since you opened this. Review it again, then delete.

account.delete.consequence.text: 這將永久刪除帳號及其所有個人檔案，無法復原。
account.delete.consequence.source: This deletes your account and all its profiles for good. It can’t be undone.

account.delete.mismatch.text: 與帳號電子郵件不符，請依帳號上顯示的內容完整輸入。
account.delete.mismatch.source: That doesn’t match your account email. Type it exactly as it appears on your account.

account.delete.ownsServers.text: 仍擁有 {servers}，請先轉移或移除後再回來繼續。
account.delete.ownsServers.source: You still own {servers}. Transfer or remove them first, then come back here.

account.delete.title.text: 要刪除 Portico Account 嗎？

account.delete.typeEmail.text: 輸入帳號電子郵件以確認
account.delete.typeEmail.source: Type your account email to confirm

account.delete.typeEmailHelp.text: 若帳號沒有電子郵件，請輸入使用者名稱。
account.delete.typeEmailHelp.source: If your account has no email, type your username.

account.hostedManagedAt.text: 密碼、登入方式、裝置與帳號安全，請在網頁上的 Portico Account 中管理。
account.hostedManagedAt.source: Password, sign-in methods, devices and account security are managed in your Portico Account on the web.

account.manageHostedHelp.text: 密碼、登入方式與安全性

account.onlyMainProfileManages.text: 個人檔案、PIN 碼與限制由主要個人檔案管理。
account.onlyMainProfileManages.source: Profiles, PINs and limits are managed from the main profile.

account.passwordMismatch.text: 兩次輸入的新密碼不一致。

account.passwordTooLong.text: 此密碼太長，請減少字元數。
account.passwordTooLong.source: This password is too long. Use fewer characters.

account.passwordWeak.text: 請使用至少 8 個字元。

account.signOutEverywhere.body.text: 登入此帳號的所有裝置（包括這台）都需要重新登入。
account.signOutEverywhere.body.source: Every device signed in to this account, including this one, will need to sign in again.

account.signOutEverywhere.title.text: 要在所有裝置上登出嗎？

account.switchFromServers.text: 請從「伺服器」切換個人檔案，可同時選擇伺服器與個人檔案。
account.switchFromServers.source: Switch profiles from Servers, where you pick the server and profile together.

account.tvHandoffTitle.text: 請在手機或電腦上管理個人檔案、PIN 碼與兩步驟驗證
account.tvHandoffTitle.source: Manage profiles, PINs and two-step verification on your phone or computer

accountSessions.error.load.text: 無法載入帳號工作階段。
accountSessions.error.load.source: Your account sessions couldn’t be loaded.

accountSessions.youWereSignedOut.text: 此帳號工作階段已結束，請重新登入。
accountSessions.youWereSignedOut.source: This account session has ended. Sign in again.

action.useAnotherServerOrAccount.text: 使用其他伺服器或帳號

activation.codeFailed.source: A code couldn’t be made right now.

activation.codeRefreshes.text: 此代碼會自動更新，登入時請保持此畫面開啟。
activation.codeRefreshes.source: This code refreshes by itself. Leave this screen open while you sign in.

activation.declined.text: 登入已在其他裝置上拒絕，請取得新代碼再試一次。
activation.declined.source: The sign-in was declined on the other device. Get a new code to try again.

activation.failed.text: Portico 無法取得登入代碼，請檢查連線後取得新代碼。
activation.failed.source: Portico couldn’t get a sign-in code. Check your connection, then get a new code.

activation.lead.text: 掃描 QR Code，或前往 {host} 並輸入代碼，再於瀏覽器中使用 Google、Apple 或 Portico Account 登入。
activation.lead.source: Scan the QR code, or visit {host} and enter the code. Sign in with Google, Apple, or your Portico Account in the browser.

activation.termsNote.text: 繼續即表示同意 Portico 的條款與隱私權政策。↵條款：getportico.tv/terms ・隱私權：getportico.tv/privacy
activation.termsNote.source:
By continuing, you agree to Portico’s terms and privacy policy.
Terms: getportico.tv/terms  •  Privacy: getportico.tv/privacy

api.credential.ended.member_disabled.text: 此人停用時即停止運作。
api.credential.ended.member_disabled.source: It stopped working when this person was disabled.

api.credential.ended.profile_deleted.text: 其個人檔案刪除時即停止運作。
api.credential.ended.profile_deleted.source: It stopped working when its profile was deleted.

api.credential.ended.unavailable.source: It no longer works. Create a new one.

api.credential.expiryDays.source: In {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

api.credential.hideEnded.source: Hide the ones that no longer work

api.credential.limitNote.text: 每組金鑰或權杖每分鐘可發出 {count} 次要求。
api.credential.limitNote.source: Each key or token may make {count} requests a minute.

api.credential.secretNotShown.text: 已建立，但此處無法再次顯示，請撤銷後建立新的。
api.credential.secretNotShown.source: It was created, but it can’t be shown again here. Revoke it and create another.

api.credential.showEnded.text: {count, plural, other {顯示 # 個已失效的項目}}
api.credential.showEnded.source: {count, plural, one {Show # that no longer works} other {Show # that no longer work}}

api.credential.state.awaiting_approval.source: Waiting for the owner to approve it

api.mcp.addressHelp.text: 這是目前使用的位址，在別處執行的助理需要能從該處連接此伺服器的位址。
api.mcp.addressHelp.source: This is the address you are using now. An assistant running somewhere else needs an address that reaches this server from there.

api.mcp.key.source: The key it signs in with

api.mcp.keyHelp.text: 建立僅具助理所需權限的 API 金鑰，連同位址提供給助理，成員可改用自己的個人存取權杖。
api.mcp.keyHelp.source: Create an API key with only what the assistant should be able to do, and give it to the assistant with the address. A member can use a personal access token of their own instead.

api.mcp.lede.text: 讓 AI 助理使用此伺服器，提供此位址與 API 金鑰或個人存取權杖給它，其僅能使用該金鑰允許的操作。
api.mcp.lede.source: Let an AI assistant work with this server. Give it this address and an API key or personal access token; it can use only what that key allows.

api.scope.admin.help.text: 可執行的所有操作，包括伺服器設定、個人檔案、成員與裝置。
api.scope.admin.help.source: Everything you can do yourself, including server settings, profiles, members and devices.

api.scope.library.help.text: 掃描、比對、編輯與刪除媒體庫內容。
api.scope.library.help.source: Scan, match, edit and delete what is in the libraries.

api.scope.playback.help.text: 播放、控制播放，以及變更自己的觀看狀態、清單、偏好設定與錄影。
api.scope.playback.help.source: Play, control playback, and change your own watch state, lists, preferences and recordings.

api.scope.read.help.text: 查看媒體庫、標題、節目表與自己的觀看狀態。
api.scope.read.help.source: Look at libraries, titles, the guide and your own watch state.

api.scopes.note.text: 金鑰或權杖的權限絕不超過建立者，且絕不能登入、變更密碼或建立其他金鑰。也可用於位址結尾，讓圖片、串流與下載可直接開啟。
api.scopes.note.source: A key or token can never do more than the person who made it, and it can never sign in, change a password or make another key. It also works at the end of an address, so artwork, streams and downloads open on their own.

api.tokens.lede.text: 用於自己的指令碼與應用程式，權杖會以你的身分登入，僅能執行建立時允許的操作。
api.tokens.lede.source: For your own scripts and apps. A token signs in as you and can do only what you allow when you create it.

api.tokens.lifetime.text: 變更密碼或在所有裝置登出後，金鑰與權杖仍有效，撤銷、到期或建立者被停用或移除時停止。
api.tokens.lifetime.source: Keys and tokens keep working when you change your password or sign out everywhere. They stop when you revoke them, when they expire, or when the person who made them is disabled or removed.

api.tokens.memberLede.text: 成員為自己的指令碼與應用程式建立的權杖，可結束其中任何一個。
api.tokens.memberLede.source: Tokens that members have made for their own scripts and apps. You can end any of them.

api.tokens.off.text: 此伺服器擁有者已關閉個人存取權杖。
api.tokens.off.source: The owner of this server has turned off personal access tokens.

api.tokens.revokeBody.text: 使用此權杖的任何功能會立即停止，無法復原。
api.tokens.revokeBody.source: Anything using this token stops working at once. This cannot be undone.

api.tokens.shownOnce.text: 權杖僅顯示這一次，伺服器只保存指紋，不保存權杖。
api.tokens.shownOnce.source: This is the only time the token is shown. The server keeps a fingerprint, not the token.

api.webhooks.dropped.text: {count, plural, other {# 個事件}}因等待過多而未保留。
api.webhooks.dropped.source: {count, plural, one {# event was} other {# events were}} not kept because too many were already waiting.

api.webhooks.error.certificate_not_trust.text: 無法驗證對方服務的安全憑證。
api.webhooks.error.certificate_not_trust.source: The other service’s security certificate could not be checked.

api.webhooks.error.could_not_connect.text: 此伺服器無法連接該位址。
api.webhooks.error.could_not_connect.source: This server could not connect to that address.

api.webhooks.error.payload_too_large.source: The message was too large to send.

api.webhooks.error.redirect_not_followed.text: 對方服務將本伺服器導向他處，請使用最終位址。
api.webhooks.error.redirect_not_followed.source: The other service sent this server somewhere else. Use the final address.

api.webhooks.error.request_failed.source: The message could not be sent.

api.webhooks.error.status.source: The other service answered with an error ({status}).

api.webhooks.error.timed_out.source: The other service took too long to answer.

api.webhooks.error.webhook_turned_off.text: 傳送前此 Webhook 已關閉。
api.webhooks.error.webhook_turned_off.source: The webhook was turned off before this was sent.

api.webhooks.event.update.available.source: A new version of Portico is available

api.webhooks.failing.text: 最近 {count, plural, other {# 次傳送}}未能送達。
api.webhooks.failing.source: The last {count, plural, one {delivery} other {# deliveries}} did not arrive.

api.webhooks.full.text: 此伺服器最多保留 {count} 個 Webhook，請移除一個再新增。
api.webhooks.full.source: This server keeps up to {count} webhooks. Remove one to add another.

api.webhooks.lede.text: 伺服器發生事件時傳送訊息至其他服務，訊息僅由本伺服器傳送。
api.webhooks.lede.source: Send a message to another service when something happens on this server. Messages are sent by this server only.

api.webhooks.removeBody.text: 不再傳送任何內容，其傳送紀錄與等待中的項目會移除。
api.webhooks.removeBody.source: Nothing more is sent to it, and its delivery log and anything still waiting are removed.

api.webhooks.rotateBody.text: 此後訊息會以新密鑰簽署，請提供給對方服務，否則將停止信任。
api.webhooks.rotateBody.source: Messages are signed with the new secret from now on. Give it to the other service, or it will stop trusting them.

api.webhooks.secretHelp.text: 留空則 Portico 會產生一個並顯示一次。
api.webhooks.secretHelp.source: Leave empty and Portico makes one and shows it to you once.

api.webhooks.secretKept.text: 簽署密鑰維持不變（結尾為 {hint}），若要變更請從 Webhook 選單選擇「更換密鑰」。
api.webhooks.secretKept.source: The signing secret stays as it is (it ends in {hint}). To change it, choose Replace the secret from the webhook’s menu.

api.webhooks.secretShownOnce.text: 密鑰僅顯示這一次，對方服務以此確認訊息確實來自本伺服器。
api.webhooks.secretShownOnce.source: This is the only time the secret is shown. The other service uses it to check that a message really came from this server.

api.webhooks.testQueued.text: 測試傳送中，結果會顯示於傳送紀錄。
api.webhooks.testQueued.source: A test is on its way. Its result will appear in the delivery log.

api.webhooks.urlHelp.text: 每個訊息的傳送位置，自己的網路位址也可。
api.webhooks.urlHelp.source: Where to send each message. An address on your own network is fine.

api.webhooks.urlProblem.text: 請使用以 http:// 或 https:// 開頭且不含使用者名稱或密碼的完整網址。
api.webhooks.urlProblem.source: Use a full web address that starts with http:// or https:// and has no user name or password in it.

api.webhooks.waiting.text: {count, plural, other {# 則訊息}}等待傳送
api.webhooks.waiting.source: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} waiting to be sent

auth.accountLead.text: 使用 Portico Account 登入，以存取與你分享的伺服器。
auth.accountLead.source: Sign in with your Portico Account to access servers shared with you.

auth.agreeToTerms.source: By continuing, you agree to the

auth.codeSentTo.text: 已將代碼寄至 {address}，請輸入以完成帳號建立。
auth.codeSentTo.source: We sent a code to {address}. Enter it to finish creating your account.

auth.direct.lead.text: 使用存在於伺服器上的帳號，僅在此裝置與該伺服器之間使用。
auth.direct.lead.source: Use an account that lives on your server. It stays between this device and that server.

auth.direct.leadTV.text: 輸入伺服器位址，再從已登入的手機或電腦核准這台電視，無需輸入密碼。
auth.direct.leadTV.source: Enter your server’s address. Then approve this TV from a phone or computer that’s already signed in. There’s no password to type.

auth.enterProfilePin.text: 輸入個人檔案 PIN 碼

auth.hostedUnreachable.text: 目前無法連接 Portico Account。
auth.hostedUnreachable.source: Couldn’t reach your Portico Account just now.

auth.noPasswordForSocial.text: 若以 Google 或 Apple 註冊，則沒有可重設的 Portico 密碼，請改用該按鈕登入。
auth.noPasswordForSocial.source: If you signed up with Google or Apple, there is no Portico password to reset: sign in with that button instead.

auth.offlineDownloadsBody.text: 無連線時也可觀看下載項目。
auth.offlineDownloadsBody.source: Watch your downloads without a connection.

auth.offlineDownloadsLede.text: 這些項目無需連線即可播放，登入後可下載更多。
auth.offlineDownloadsLede.source: These play without a connection. Sign in to download more.

auth.oneAccount.text: 一個 Portico Account 即可存取擁有或他人分享的所有伺服器。
auth.oneAccount.source: One Portico Account reaches every server you own or that someone shares with you.

auth.privacySameAnswer.text: 為保護隱私，無論帳號是否存在，回覆皆相同。
auth.privacySameAnswer.source: For your privacy the answer is the same whether or not an account matches.

auth.resetLinkLede.text: 輸入使用者名稱與帳號上的電子郵件，我們會寄送重設密碼連結。
auth.resetLinkLede.source: Enter your username and the email on your account. We’ll email you a link to reset your password.

auth.resetLinkLedeEmail.text: 輸入帳號上的電子郵件，我們會寄送重設密碼連結。
auth.resetLinkLedeEmail.source: Enter the email on your account. We’ll email you a link to reset your password.

auth.resetLinkSent.text: 已寄出重設密碼連結，請在任何裝置上開啟，再以新密碼在此登入。
auth.resetLinkSent.source: We’ve sent a link to reset your password. Open it on any device, then sign in here with your new password.

auth.savedUnreachable.text: 目前無法連接，Portico 會持續嘗試。
auth.savedUnreachable.source: Couldn’t reach it just now. Portico keeps trying.

auth.signInDirectly.source: Sign in directly to a server

auth.signInWithAccount.text: 使用 Portico Account 登入
auth.signInWithAccount.source: Sign in with a Portico Account

auth.signInWithAccountTitle.text: 使用 Portico Account 登入

auth.tvGoogleHint.text: 若要使用 Google 登入，請返回並用手機掃描代碼。
auth.tvGoogleHint.source: To sign in with Google, go back and scan the code with your phone.

auth.useCodeFromAnotherDevice.source: Use a code from another device

auth.usernameHelp.text: 可用字母、數字、句點與連字號，供他人與你分享伺服器時使用。
auth.usernameHelp.source: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes. People use it to share a server with you.

auth.usernameOrEmail.text: 使用者名稱或電子郵件

builder.audience.text: 有這些媒體庫存取權的人皆可看到此頻道。
builder.audience.source: Everyone with access to these libraries sees this channel.

builder.empty.body.text: 媒體庫頻道會依節目表播放自己的電影與影集，如電視頻道般，請描述播放內容，如「僅 1985 年的電影」或「只有一部影集」。
builder.empty.body.source: A Library Channel plays your own movies and shows on a schedule, like a TV channel. Describe what it plays, like “only movies from 1985” or “nothing but one show”.

builder.episodes.marathon.source: Marathon: one show at a time

builder.episodes.rotate.source: One episode of each show in turn

builder.error.conditions.text: 其中一個條件無法使用，請變更或移除。
builder.error.conditions.source: One of these conditions can’t be used. Change or remove it.

builder.error.kinds.source: Choose movies, TV shows, or both.

builder.error.mentions.text: 請使用 200 個字元以內。

builder.error.pins.text: 其中一個標題無法釘選，請移除後再試一次。
builder.error.pins.source: One of these titles can’t be pinned. Remove it, then try again.

builder.error.preview.text: 無法產生預覽，變更已保留。
builder.error.preview.source: The preview couldn’t be made. Your changes are kept.

builder.error.rejected.text: 伺服器未接受此頻道，請檢查名稱、媒體庫、條件與時區後再試一次。
builder.error.rejected.source: The server didn’t accept this channel. Check its name, libraries, conditions and time zone, then try again.

builder.error.save.text: 無法儲存頻道，請檢查醒目提示的欄位後再試一次。
builder.error.save.source: The channel couldn’t be saved. Check the highlighted field, then try again.

builder.error.timeZone.text: 請輸入如 America/New_York 的時區。
builder.error.timeZone.source: Enter a time zone like America/New_York.

builder.hours.text: 約 {hours, plural, other {# 小時}}的節目
builder.hours.source: About {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of programming

builder.matches.text: {count, plural, =0 {沒有標題符合} other {# 個標題符合}}
builder.matches.source: {count, plural, =0 {No titles match} one {# title matches} other {# titles match}}

builder.mentionsHint.text: 詞語，如「鯊魚」，每個詞都須出現。
builder.mentionsHint.source: Words, like “shark”. Every word must appear.

builder.noConditions.text: 無條件：所選媒體庫中的所有內容皆播放。
builder.noConditions.source: No conditions: everything in the chosen libraries plays.

builder.noMatchesHelp.text: 放寬條件或選擇更多媒體庫。
builder.noMatchesHelp.source: Loosen a condition, or choose more libraries.

builder.noVideoLibraries.text: 請先新增電影或影集媒體庫。
builder.noVideoLibraries.source: Add a movie or TV library first.

builder.opaqueConditions.text: 此頻道使用的條件無法在此顯示，會維持原樣。
builder.opaqueConditions.source: This channel uses conditions the builder can’t show. They’re kept as they are.

builder.previewEmpty.text: 選擇媒體庫以查看將播放的內容。
builder.previewEmpty.source: Choose a library to see what would play.

builder.showsNote.text: 影集的條件適用於影集本身（類型、電視網、分級），每集皆播放。
builder.showsNote.source: For TV shows, conditions apply to the show (its genre, network, rating) and every episode plays.

dvr.reason.graceWait.source: Waiting a moment after recording and playback finish.

dvr.reason.guideMissing.text: 此節目已不在節目表中。
dvr.reason.guideMissing.source: This program is no longer in the guide.

dvr.reason.inUse.text: 等待無人觀看時再進行。

dvr.reason.missed.text: 節目在錄影開始前已結束。
dvr.reason.missed.source: The program ended before recording could start.

dvr.reason.partial.source: Only part of the program was recorded.

dvr.reason.recoveredPartial.source: What was recovered plays, but may not cover the whole program.

dvr.reason.removeRetry.source: The file couldn’t be removed yet. Portico will try again.

dvr.reason.sourceChanged.text: 錄影期間來源已變更，已錄得的部分會保留。
dvr.reason.sourceChanged.source: The source changed during recording. What was captured is kept.

dvr.reason.storageFloor.text: 已停止以保留伺服器可用空間。
dvr.reason.storageFloor.source: Stopped to keep free space on the server.

error.artworkPending.source: This artwork isn’t ready yet. Try again in a moment.

error.busy.text: 伺服器目前忙碌中，請稍後再試一次。
error.busy.source: Your server is busy right now. Try again in a moment.

error.changed.text: 查看期間內容已變更，請重新整理以查看最新狀態。
error.changed.source: This changed while you were looking at it. Refresh to see the latest.

error.confirmationMismatch.text: 輸入內容不符，請檢查後再試一次。
error.confirmationMismatch.source: What you typed doesn’t match. Check it and try again.

error.credentialLimit.text: 此伺服器上的此類項目已達上限，請撤銷不再使用的一個後再試一次。

error.invalidInput.text: 部分資料未獲接受，請檢查後再試一次。
error.invalidInput.source: Some details weren’t accepted. Check them and try again.

error.invalidResponse.text: 伺服器傳送了 Portico 無法讀取的內容，請確認伺服器為最新版本。

error.live.invalidInput.text: 無法使用此播放清單或節目表，請檢查位址後再試一次。
error.live.invalidInput.source: The playlist or guide couldn’t be used. Check the addresses and try again.

error.live.networkPolicy.text: 此位址位於住家網路，僅在信任該裝置時確認。
error.live.networkPolicy.source: This address is on your home network. Confirm it only if you trust the device.

error.live.previewExpired.source: This source changed, or it was checked too long ago. Check the source again.

error.live.tunersBusy.text: 此來源的調諧器都在收看或保留給錄影。
error.live.tunersBusy.source: All of this source’s tuners are being watched or kept for recordings.

error.live.unavailable.source: The source couldn’t be reached, or answered with something Portico can’t read. The guide you already have is kept.

error.metadataUnavailable.source: Metadata is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.

error.notFound.text: 此內容已無法使用，可能已被移除或存取權限已變更。
error.notFound.source: This isn’t available anymore. It may have been removed, or your access may have changed.

error.offline.text: 此裝置已離線，請檢查連線後再試一次。
error.offline.source: This device is offline. Check your connection, then try again.

error.offlineRetrying.text: 此裝置已離線，Portico 會在可以時重新連線。
error.offlineRetrying.source: This device is offline. Portico will reconnect as soon as it can.

error.permission.source: Your profile doesn’t have access to this. Ask the server’s owner if you think it should.

error.queueTooLarge.text: 此佇列太長，請移除部分項目或建立新的佇列。
error.queueTooLarge.source: This queue is too long. Remove some of it or start a new one.

error.rateLimited.text: 嘗試次數過多，請稍候再試一次。
error.rateLimited.source: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.

error.rateLimitedSeconds.text: 嘗試次數過多，請在 {seconds, plural, other {# 秒}}後再試一次。
error.rateLimitedSeconds.source: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

error.screenCrashed.source: Something went wrong on this screen.

error.storageFull.text: 伺服器儲存空間不足，請釋出空間後再試一次。
error.storageFull.source: Your server is out of storage space. Free some space, then try again.

error.timeout.text: 伺服器回應逾時，請稍後再試一次。
error.timeout.source: Your server took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.

server.storage.category.artwork.descript.text: 伺服器已取得、擷取或收到的海報、背景圖和縮圖。
server.storage.category.artwork.descript.source: Posters, backdrops and thumbnails the server has fetched, extracted or been given.

server.storage.category.conversions.desc.text: 串流轉檔時寫入的片段。沒有播放內容時可安全刪除。
server.storage.category.conversions.desc.source: Segments written while a stream was being converted. Safe to remove when nothing is playing.

server.storage.category.downloads.descri.text: 準備好讓用戶端離線取用的套件。
server.storage.category.downloads.descri.source: Packages staged for a client to take offline.

server.storage.category.live-cache.descr.text: 已緩衝的直播與頻道片段。

server.storage.category.prepared-media.d.text: 為下載或無法播放原始檔的裝置而預先最佳化的版本。
server.storage.category.prepared-media.d.source: Optimised versions prepared for download or for a device that cannot play the original.

server.storage.category.recordings.descr.text: 已擷取的錄影。這些屬於內容，維護頁面絕不會移除。
server.storage.category.recordings.descr.source: Captured recordings. These are content: the maintenance page never removes them.

server.storage.category.subtitles.descri.text: 已擷取、下載與渲染的字幕軌。
server.storage.category.subtitles.descri.source: Extracted, downloaded and rendered subtitle tracks.

server.storage.category.trickplay.descri.text: 每個檔案產生的拖曳進度預覽圖。通常是最大、可重新產生的一類。
server.storage.category.trickplay.descri.source: Scrubbing tiles generated per file. This is usually the largest regenerable category.

server.updates.checkHelp.text: 伺服器會尋找新版本並在此告知，Portico 絕不會自行安裝更新。
server.updates.checkHelp.source: The server looks for a newer version and tells you here. Portico never installs an update by itself.

server.usage.artwork.text: 來自媒體資料夾的圖片

server.usage.connectionsHelp.text: 另有 {reserve} 個保留給此控制台與登入使用。
server.usage.connectionsHelp.source: Another {reserve} are always kept for this console and for signing in.

server.usage.lede.text: 伺服器目前的用量，以及可設定的上限。
server.usage.lede.source: What the server is using at the moment, beside the limits you can set.

servers.connectDirect.source: Sign in directly to a server

servers.switch.text: 切換個人檔案或伺服器

settings.connectedThroughAccount.text: 透過 Portico Account 連線

settings.help.audioLanguages.text: Portico 會選擇標題具備的第一個語言，未選擇時播放標題的原始音軌。
settings.help.audioLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has. With none chosen, it plays the title’s original track.

settings.help.backdrops.text: 標題頁面與首頁背後的圖片。
settings.help.backdrops.source: Artwork behind title pages and Home.

settings.help.disableHdr.text: 若 HDR 標題看起來灰白、褪色或過暗請開啟。
settings.help.disableHdr.source: Turn this on if HDR titles look grey, washed out or too dark.

settings.help.disablePassthrough.text: 若 Dolby 或 DTS 標題播放無聲請開啟。
settings.help.disablePassthrough.source: Turn this on if Dolby or DTS titles play without sound.

settings.help.forceStereo.text: 若環繞音效無聲或缺少人聲請開啟。
settings.help.forceStereo.source: Turn this on if surround sound is silent or voices are missing.

settings.help.gapless.source: No silence between songs that run into each other.

settings.help.layout.text: 電視：遙控器焦點與大字；觸控：手機與平板電腦螢幕。Portico 會重新啟動以切換。
settings.help.layout.source: Television: remote-control focus and large type. Touch: phone and tablet screens. Portico restarts to change it.

settings.help.libraryView.text: 已切換過的媒體庫會保留自己的檢視。
settings.help.libraryView.source: A library you have switched keeps its own view.

settings.help.lyrics.text: 歌曲有歌詞時跟隨時間顯示。
settings.help.lyrics.source: Follow along in time with the song when it has lyrics.

settings.help.playbackMethod.text: 自動會在裝置可行時播放原始檔，不可行時轉檔。
settings.help.playbackMethod.source: Automatic plays the original file when this device can, and converts it when it can’t.

settings.help.player.text: 自動會在裝置可直接播放標題時使用裝置自己的播放器，否則須轉檔或燒入字幕時使用 mpv。
settings.help.player.source: Automatic uses this device’s own player when it can play a title as it is, and mpv when the title would otherwise have to be converted or have its subtitles burned in.

settings.help.qualityAway.text: 在其他網路時。自動從原始檔開始，連線需要時才降畫質，許可時再升回。
settings.help.qualityAway.source: On any other network. Automatic starts with the original, lowers the quality only while your connection needs it, and raises it again when it can.

settings.help.qualityHome.text: 此裝置在伺服器住家網路時。原始檔按原樣播放每個檔案，自動從此開始並依連線調整，可在播放器中為單次觀看選擇其他畫質。
settings.help.qualityHome.source: When this device is on your server’s home network. Original plays every file as it is; Automatic starts there and adjusts to your connection. You can pick another quality for one viewing in the player.

settings.help.receiveFromDevices.text: 讓手機或電腦在此電視上開始播放。
settings.help.receiveFromDevices.source: Lets your phone or computer start playback on this TV.

settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.text: 較短的轉場效果，Portico 也會遵循此裝置的減少動態效果設定。
settings.help.reduceMotionDevice.source: Shorter transitions. Portico also follows the Reduce Motion setting of this device.

settings.help.showActivity.text: 讓此伺服器上的他人看到觀看內容，並計入「此伺服器上的熱門內容」。
settings.help.showActivity.source: Lets others on this server see what you’re watching, and counts it in “Popular on this server”.

settings.help.stillWatching.text: 遙控器一段時間無人操作後，連續播放數集後暫停。
settings.help.stillWatching.source: Pauses after several episodes in a row when no one has touched the controls.

settings.help.subtitleLanguages.text: Portico 會選擇標題具備的第一個語言。
settings.help.subtitleLanguages.source: Portico picks the first of these a title has.

settings.help.subtitleMode.text: 強制字幕僅翻譯以其他語言說出的台詞。
settings.help.subtitleMode.source: Forced subtitles translate only the lines spoken in another language.

settings.help.tvHdr.text: 若電視可顯示 HDR 請開啟，HDR 標題會按原樣傳送，不再轉為標準動態範圍。
settings.help.tvHdr.source: Turn on if your TV shows HDR. HDR titles are then sent as they are instead of being converted to standard range.

settings.help.tvSurround.text: 若電視或連接的音響系統可播放 5.1 或 7.1 聲音請開啟，會保留環繞音效而不混音為立體聲。
settings.help.tvSurround.source: Turn on if your TV, or a sound system connected to it, plays 5.1 or 7.1 sound. Surround is then kept instead of being mixed down to stereo.

settings.help.volumeLeveling.text: 以相近的響度播放歌曲或專輯。
settings.help.volumeLeveling.source: Plays songs or albums at a similar loudness.

settings.layout.restart.text: Portico 會重新啟動以使用新版面。
settings.layout.restart.source: Portico restarts to use the new layout.

settings.linkTVHelp.text: 使用電視顯示的代碼登入電視
settings.linkTVHelp.source: Sign a TV in with the code it shows

settings.notSaved.text: 該變更未儲存，請再試一次。
settings.notSaved.source: That change wasn’t saved. Try again.

settings.openOnWeb.text: 用手機掃描代碼，或在電腦上前往 {url}。
settings.openOnWeb.source: Scan the code with your phone, or go to {url} on a computer.

settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.text: Portico 將忘記已學習到的喜好，觀看紀錄、評分與清單會保留。
settings.resetRecommendations.confirmBod.source: Portico will forget what it has learned about your taste. Your watch history, ratings and lists stay.

settings.resetRecommendations.failed.text: 無法重設推薦，請再試一次。
settings.resetRecommendations.failed.source: Recommendations couldn’t be reset. Try again.

settings.resetRecommendations.help.text: 重新開始 Portico 為你推薦的內容。
settings.resetRecommendations.help.source: Start over with what Portico recommends to you.

settings.row.disablePassthrough.text: 不將聲音直通至擴大機
settings.row.disablePassthrough.source: Don’t send sound to my receiver untouched

settings.row.startNextDuringCredits.source: Start the next episode during the credits

settings.row.unreadBadge.source: Show a dot for new notifications

settings.save.afterRestart.text: 伺服器重新啟動後生效
settings.save.afterRestart.source: Takes effect after the server restarts

settings.save.failed.text: 並非所有內容都已儲存。

settings.section.playbackFixes.source: If something looks or sounds wrong

settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.text: 除非標題在此裝置播放不佳，否則保持關閉。
settings.section.playbackFixesHelp.source: Leave these off unless a title plays badly on this device.

settings.section.tvOutputs.text: 此電視可顯示與播放的內容
settings.section.tvOutputs.source: What this TV can show and play

settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.text: 此裝置無法得知電視與音響系統的支援能力，因此在另行設定前，Portico 一律以標準動態範圍與立體聲播放。
settings.section.tvOutputsHelp.source: This device can’t tell what your TV and sound system support, so Portico plays everything in standard range and stereo until you say otherwise.

settings.server.accountCapHelp.text: 適用於每個帳號，個人的上限於「人員」中的帳號設定。
settings.server.accountCapHelp.source: Applies to each account. A person’s own limit is set on their account in People.

settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.text: 住家外連接此伺服器的位址，如 https://media.example.com，請使用不含路徑的主機名稱。
settings.server.advertiseUrlHelp.source: The address people outside your home use to reach this server, such as https://media.example.com. Use a hostname with no path after it.

settings.server.allowConverting.text: 轉換裝置無法播放的影片
settings.server.allowConverting.source: Convert video a device can’t play

settings.server.apiRate.text: 每組金鑰或權杖可發出的要求
settings.server.apiRate.source: Requests each key or token may make

settings.server.apiRateHelp.text: 超過此頻率要求的金鑰或權杖會被要求等待，使用應用程式的人絕不受影響，留空使用通常的每分鐘 600 次。
settings.server.apiRateHelp.source: A key or token that asks more often than this is told to wait. People using the apps are never slowed by it. Leave empty for the usual 600 a minute.

settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.text: Portico 掃描、比對、分析、圖片與維護的效能，輕量適合小型伺服器，快速可較早完成大量匯入，播放永遠優先。
settings.server.backgroundSpeedHelp.source: How hard Portico works at scanning, matching, analysis, artwork and maintenance. Gentle suits a small server. Fast finishes a large import sooner. Playback always comes first.

settings.server.capabilities.text: 此伺服器可執行的功能

settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.text: 伺服器一次接受的最多連線數，留空由伺服器依記憶體決定，控制台與登入一定保留名額，變更於伺服器重新啟動後生效。
settings.server.connectionLimitHelp.source: The most connections the server accepts at once. Leave empty and the server chooses from its memory. The console and sign-in always keep room of their own. A change takes effect after the server restarts.

settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.text: 無人觀看的轉檔，絕不佔用觀看者的名額。
settings.server.conversionsBackgroundHel.source: Conversions nobody is watching. They never take a slot from someone who is.

settings.server.conversionsHelp.text: 需要轉檔的後續串流會等待或以較低畫質播放。
settings.server.conversionsHelp.source: Further streams that need converting wait or play at a lower quality.

settings.server.detailWindow.text: 記錄更多詳細資料 30 分鐘

settings.server.detailWindow.help.text: 會開啟詳細訊息，之後自行關閉。
settings.server.detailWindow.help.source: Turns on detailed messages, then turns itself off.

settings.server.discoveryHelp.text: 讓網路上的應用程式無需輸入位址即可找到伺服器。
settings.server.discoveryHelp.source: Lets apps on your network find the server without typing an address.

settings.server.dlnaHelp.text: 讓家中網路上的電視、遊戲機和其他 DLNA 裝置無需登入，即可瀏覽並播放這部伺服器上的所有內容。
settings.server.dlnaHelp.source: Lets TVs, consoles and other DLNA devices on your home network browse and play everything on this server, without signing in.

settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.text: 越快越省處理器，相同大小下畫面略柔。
settings.server.encoderSpeedHelp.source: Faster uses less processor and gives a slightly softer picture at the same size.

settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.text: 應用程式可嘗試的其他位址，如 VPN 名稱，應用程式會自行測試。
settings.server.extraAddressesHelp.source: More addresses apps may try, such as a VPN name. Apps test each one themselves.

settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.text: 留空使用 Portico 內建的 FFmpeg，若要使用其他建構請提供完整路徑，儲存時 Portico 會檢查，伺服器重新啟動後開始使用。
settings.server.ffmpegChosenHelp.source: Leave empty to use the FFmpeg that comes with Portico. To use another build, give its full path. Portico checks it when you save and starts using it after the server restarts.

settings.server.hardware.vaapi.text: VA-API（Linux 的 Intel 與 AMD）

settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.text: 留空讓伺服器選擇，在 Linux 上為算繪裝置路徑。
settings.server.hardwareDeviceHelp.source: Leave empty to let the server choose. On Linux, a render device path.

settings.server.hardwareHelp.text: 自動會使用此伺服器的圖形硬體，並退回處理器。
settings.server.hardwareHelp.source: Automatic uses the graphics hardware this server has, and falls back to the processor.

settings.server.homeNetworkLede.text: 這些網路決定何謂住家，身處他處的裝置視為外地，會套用外地規則與限制。
settings.server.homeNetworkLede.source: These networks decide what counts as home. A device anywhere else is away from home, and the away-from-home rules and limits apply to it.

settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.text: 位址或範圍，如 192.168.2.0/24，清單以常用的私人範圍與伺服器所連網路為起點，VPN 範圍若應視為住家請加入，清單為空時每台裝置皆為外地。
settings.server.homeNetworksHelp.source: An address or a range, such as 192.168.2.0/24. The list starts with the usual private ranges and the networks this server is attached to. Add a VPN range if it should count as home. With an empty list, every device is away from home.

settings.server.jobs.never.text: 未排定：沒有啟用的時段包含它
settings.server.jobs.never.source: Not scheduled: no enabled window includes it

settings.server.keep.downloads.text: 保留準備好的下載項目

settings.server.keep.prepared.text: 保留未使用的準備媒體

settings.server.memberTokensMay.text: 成員可建立自己的權杖
settings.server.memberTokensMay.source: Members may make their own tokens

settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.text: 選擇「不行」會停止建立新權杖，既有權杖會運作至結束為止。
settings.server.memberTokensMayHelp.source: Choosing No stops new tokens. Tokens that already exist keep working until you end them.

settings.server.missingTitlesLede.text: 檔案已不在磁碟的標題會留在媒體庫並標示為遺失，檔案恢復後標題也會回來並保持原狀。
settings.server.missingTitlesLede.source: A title whose files are no longer on disk stays in the library, marked missing. If the files come back, so does the title, with everything as it was.

settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.text: 觀看紀錄一定保留，標題再次加入時會回來。
settings.server.missingTitlesRuleHelp.source: Watch history is kept either way, and returns if a title is added again.

settings.server.ownCertificateLede.text: 用於無反向代理的自己網域：此伺服器上的憑證與金鑰檔（PEM 格式）及其涵蓋的網域，續期的檔案會自行採用。
settings.server.ownCertificateLede.source: For your own domain without a reverse proxy: the certificate and key files on this server, in PEM form, and the domain they cover. The server picks up renewed files by itself.

settings.server.pauseBackground.source: Pause background work for an hour

settings.server.planning.source: When a device can’t play a file

settings.server.planning.maximum_compati.source: Play on as many devices as possible

settings.server.planning.minimize_server.source: Do the least work on the server

settings.server.planningHelp.text: 伺服器選擇傳送方式時的偏好。
settings.server.planningHelp.source: What the server favors when it chooses how to deliver a title.

settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.text: 除非設定天數，否則保留每次播放，播放次數一定保留。
settings.server.playHistoryKeepHelp.source: Every play is kept unless you set a number of days. Play counts are kept either way.

settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.text: 住家網路外所有人的最高位元速率。
settings.server.qualityLimitHelp.source: Highest bitrate for anyone outside your home network.

settings.server.remote.notSetUp.text: 此伺服器尚未設定遠端存取。
settings.server.remote.notSetUp.source: Remote access is not set up on this server.

settings.server.remote.off.text: 遠端存取已關閉，住家網路裝置照常連接。
settings.server.remote.off.source: Remote access is off. Devices on your home network connect as usual.

settings.server.repackage.text: 可行時重新封裝而非轉檔
settings.server.repackage.source: Repackage instead of converting when that is enough

settings.server.repackageHelp.text: 僅變更檔案容器，畫面與聲音保持原樣。
settings.server.repackageHelp.source: Changes only the file’s container and keeps the picture and sound as they are.

settings.server.retentionLede.text: 紀錄、產生的檔案與備份在伺服器移除前保留多久。
settings.server.retentionLede.source: How long records, generated files and backups stay before the server removes them.

settings.server.secure.connectHelp.text: 會在新視窗開啟 Portico Account 以核准此伺服器，僅此而已，憑證會自行跟上。
settings.server.secure.connectHelp.source: Opens your Portico Account in a new window, where you approve this server. That’s all: the certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.text: 會在瀏覽器開啟此伺服器的設定，於 Portico Account 中核准，或在此應用程式登入 Portico Account 以在此完成。
settings.server.secure.connectInBrowserH.source: Opens this server’s settings in your browser, where you approve it in your Portico Account. Or sign in to your Portico Account in this app to do it here.

settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.text: 將此伺服器連接至 Portico Account 並取得憑證，無其他操作。
settings.server.secure.connectWithAccoun.source: Connects this server to your Portico Account and gets its certificate. Nothing else to do.

settings.server.secure.connected.text: 已連接，Portico 正在取得憑證。
settings.server.secure.connected.source: Connected. Portico is getting the certificate now.

settings.server.secure.lede.text: 以每個瀏覽器與應用程式都信任的憑證，在住家與外地加密裝置與此伺服器之間的所有內容，Portico 會取得並續期。
settings.server.secure.lede.source: Encrypts everything between your devices and this server, at home and away, with a certificate every browser and app trusts. Portico gets it and renews it for you.

settings.server.secure.notSetUp.text: 裝置以一般 HTTP 連接，若要開啟安全連線，請將此伺服器連接至 Portico Account，Portico 會自行取得並續期憑證，或使用下方自己的憑證。
settings.server.secure.notSetUp.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, connect this server to your Portico Account: Portico then gets and renews a certificate by itself. Or use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.text: 裝置以一般 HTTP 連接，若要開啟安全連線，請使用下方自己的憑證。
settings.server.secure.notSetUpOwnOnly.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. To turn on a secure connection, use your own certificate, below.

settings.server.secure.off.text: 裝置以一般 HTTP 連接，請開啟「使用安全連線」以重新加密連線。
settings.server.secure.off.source: Devices connect with plain HTTP. Turn on “Use a secure connection” to encrypt their connection again.

settings.server.secure.on.text: 裝置在住家與外地皆安全連接此伺服器。
settings.server.secure.on.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away.

settings.server.secure.onAt.text: 裝置在住家與外地皆安全連接此伺服器，其安全位址為 {address}。
settings.server.secure.onAt.source: Devices connect to this server securely, at home and away. Its secure address is {address}.

settings.server.secure.own.text: 裝置以自己的憑證安全連接。
settings.server.secure.own.source: Devices connect securely with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.ownAt.text: 裝置以自己的憑證安全連接至 {address}。
settings.server.secure.ownAt.source: Devices connect securely to {address} with your own certificate.

settings.server.secure.portHelp.text: 住家外裝置用於安全位址的連接埠。
settings.server.secure.portHelp.source: The port devices use for the secure address from outside your home.

settings.server.secure.starting.text: Portico 正在為此伺服器取得憑證，通常需一兩分鐘，期間無需任何操作。
settings.server.secure.starting.source: Portico is getting a certificate for this server. This usually takes a minute or two; nothing needs doing meanwhile.

settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.text: 關閉時，裝置以一般 HTTP 連接，仍可運作，只是連線未加密。
settings.server.secure.toggleHelp.source: When this is off, devices connect with plain HTTP. They still work; their connection just isn’t encrypted.

settings.server.secure.waiting.text: 請在 Portico Account 中核准此伺服器以完成，憑證會自行跟上。
settings.server.secure.waiting.source: Approve this server in your Portico Account to finish. The certificate follows by itself.

settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.text: 轉換中的串流可用於工作檔的磁碟空間，達到上限時會先移除已播放的部分。
settings.server.sessionSpaceHelp.source: How much disk a stream being converted may use for its working files. When it is reached, the parts already played are removed first.

settings.server.skippedParts.text: 此應用程式無法讀取的部分
settings.server.skippedParts.source: Parts this app could not read

settings.server.skippedPartsCount.source: {count, plural, one {# left out} other {# left out}}

web.account.notif.securityBody.text: 若非本人操作，請檢查裝置並變更密碼。
web.account.notif.securityBody.source: If it wasn’t you, review your devices and change your password.

web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.text: Portico 已有一段時間未收到此伺服器的消息，請檢查其電源與網路連線。
web.account.notif.serverOfflineBody.source: Portico hasn’t heard from this server for a while. Check its power and network connection.

web.account.notif.storageBody.text: 新增更多媒體前請釋出空間。
web.account.notif.storageBody.source: Free up space before adding more media.

web.account.ownerResetsPassword.text: 若忘記密碼，伺服器擁有者可協助重設。
web.account.ownerResetsPassword.source: If you forget your password, the server’s owner can reset it.

web.account.passwordChangedBody.text: 新密碼即刻生效，已登入的裝置會保持登入，需要時可在下方登出。
web.account.passwordChangedBody.source: Your new password works from now on. Devices that are already signed in stay signed in; sign them out below if you need to.

web.account.passwordHelp.source: Used to sign in to this server

web.account.porticoMemberBody.text: 以 Portico Account 登入此伺服器，因此密碼與兩步驟驗證在該處管理，個人檔案、PIN 碼與已登入裝置在此管理。
web.account.porticoMemberBody.source: You sign in to this server with your Portico Account, so your password and two-step verification are managed there. Profiles, PINs and signed-in devices are managed here.

web.account.profilesHelp.text: 每個個人檔案各自保留觀看紀錄、我的片單與偏好設定。
web.account.profilesHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences.

web.account.profilesHostedHelp.text: 每個個人檔案各自保留觀看紀錄、我的片單與偏好設定，請在 Portico Account 中新增、重新命名與移除。
web.account.profilesHostedHelp.source: Each profile keeps its own history, My List and preferences. Add, rename and remove them in your Portico Account.

web.account.switchProfileOrServer.text: 切換個人檔案或伺服器

web.accountReturn.body.text: 正在返回 Portico 應用程式以完成登入。
web.accountReturn.body.source: Returning to the Portico app to finish signing in.

web.accountReturn.invalid.text: 請在 Portico 應用程式中重新登入。
web.accountReturn.invalid.source: Start signing in again in the Portico app.

web.activity.noTasksBody.text: 掃描、中繼資料更新與維護會在執行時顯示於此。
web.activity.noTasksBody.source: Scans, metadata refreshes and maintenance appear here as they run.

web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.text: 提前天數。憑證會自行續期，僅在續期卡住時觸發。
web.alerts.certificateWarningHelp.source: Days ahead. Certificates renew by themselves; this only fires if renewal is stuck.

web.alerts.lede.text: 伺服器在通知中發出警告的時機。
web.alerts.lede.source: When the server puts a warning in your notifications.

web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.text: 到此程度錄影與轉檔可能開始失敗
web.alerts.storageCriticalHelp.source: Recordings and conversions may start failing at this point

web.alerts.storageWarning.source: Warn when free space falls below

web.alerts.storageWarningHelp.source: Percent of a drive that is still free

web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.text: 訊息最多 1000 位元組，此為 {count} 位元組。
web.broadcast.bodyTooLong.source: Messages can be at most 1000 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.broadcast.lede.text: 會顯示於每個人的通知，不是電子郵件。
web.broadcast.lede.source: Appears in each person’s notifications. It is not an email.

web.broadcast.titleExample.text: 伺服器將於週六上午停機
web.broadcast.titleExample.source: The server will be down on Saturday morning

web.broadcast.titleTooLong.text: 標題最多 200 位元組，此為 {count} 位元組。
web.broadcast.titleTooLong.source: Titles can be at most 200 bytes; this one is {count} bytes.

web.browser.unsupportedBody.text: Portico 需要 Chrome 或 Edge 111、Firefox 113、Safari 16.4 以上版本，請更新此瀏覽器或改用其他瀏覽器開啟 Portico。
web.browser.unsupportedBody.source: Portico needs Chrome or Edge 111, Firefox 113, Safari 16.4 or newer. Update this browser or open Portico in another one.

web.browser.unsupportedTitle.text: 此瀏覽器過舊，無法使用 Portico
web.browser.unsupportedTitle.source: This browser is too old for Portico

web.capabilities.help.text: 此伺服器目前可執行的功能，以及不可執行時的原因。
web.capabilities.help.source: What this server can do right now, and why not when it can’t.

web.capabilities.notChecked.text: 伺服器尚未檢查此項目，首次使用或設定該功能時會檢查。
web.capabilities.notChecked.source: The server hasn’t checked this yet. It does when the feature is first used or set up.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.text: 伺服器擁有者已關閉影片工具的隔離。
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxOf.source: The server owner turned off isolation for the video tools.

web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.text: 此主機無法隔離影片工具，因此轉檔會以基本保護執行。
web.capabilities.reason.decoderSandboxUn.source: This host can’t isolate the video tools, so conversions run with baseline protections.

web.capabilities.reason.delivery.text: 此伺服器尚未設定頻道播放。
web.capabilities.reason.delivery.source: Channel playback isn’t set up on this server.

web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.text: 影片工具已安裝，但缺少所需的函式庫。
web.capabilities.reason.dependencies.source: The video tools are installed, but some of the libraries they need can’t be found.

web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.text: 此伺服器會以近似色彩轉換杜比視界，供無法顯示的螢幕使用。
web.capabilities.reason.dolbyVisionAppro.source: This server converts Dolby Vision with approximate colors on screens that can’t show it.

web.capabilities.reason.hardware.text: 選擇的硬體編碼器在此伺服器上無法使用，因此改用處理器。
web.capabilities.reason.hardware.source: The hardware encoder you chose isn’t usable on this server, so the processor is used instead.

web.capabilities.reason.other.text: Portico 無法在此啟用此功能，原因請見技術詳細資料。
web.capabilities.reason.other.source: Portico couldn’t turn this on here. Technical details has the cause.

web.capabilities.reason.platform.text: 此伺服器的作業系統尚無法隔離此功能所需的 Portico 影片工具。
web.capabilities.reason.platform.source: This server’s operating system can’t isolate the video tools Portico needs for this yet.

web.capabilities.reason.tools.text: 此伺服器上尚未設定 FFmpeg 與 ffprobe。
web.capabilities.reason.tools.source: FFmpeg and ffprobe aren’t set up on this server.

web.channelBuilder.templatesFailed.text: 無法載入範本，請再試一次

web.channelProblem.general.text: 此頻道目前無法播放，請再試一次或選擇其他頻道。
web.channelProblem.general.source: This channel can’t play right now. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.text: 頻道來源沒有回應，請一分鐘後再試一次。
web.channelProblem.sourceUnavailable.source: The channel’s source isn’t responding. Try again in a minute.

web.channelProblem.stalled.text: 頻道準備耗時過久，請再試一次。
web.channelProblem.stalled.source: The channel took too long to get ready. Try again.

web.channelProblem.startFailed.text: 伺服器無法啟動此頻道，請再試一次或選擇其他頻道。
web.channelProblem.startFailed.source: The server couldn’t start this channel. Try again, or pick another channel.

web.channelProblem.storage.text: 伺服器目前沒有緩衝直播電視的空間，擁有者可在「伺服器」›「儲存空間」釋出空間。
web.channelProblem.storage.source: The server has no room to buffer live TV right now. The owner can free up space in Server › Storage.

web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.text: 所有調諧器都在錄影或使用中，請有空閒時再試一次。
web.channelProblem.tunersBusy.source: All tuners are busy recording or in use. Try again when one frees up.

web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.text: Portico Account 目前沒有回應，{server} 不受影響，恢復後 Portico 即會開啟。
web.chooser.accountWaitingBody.source: Portico Accounts aren’t answering right now. {server} isn’t affected; Portico will open it as soon as they’re back.

web.chooser.lede.source: Choose the server to watch from.

web.chooser.noneBody.text: 設定 Portico 伺服器並連接至此帳號，或開啟伺服器擁有者的邀請。
web.chooser.noneBody.source: Set up a Portico server and connect it to this account, or open an invitation from a server’s owner.

web.chooser.signInDirectly.source: Sign in directly to this server

web.chooser.waitingBody.text: 恢復後 Portico 會自動連接。
web.chooser.waitingBody.source: Portico will connect automatically when it’s back.

web.claim.checkAddress.text: 僅在從自己的伺服器發起且上方地址正確時核准。
web.claim.checkAddress.source: Approve only if you started this from your own server and the address above is yours.

web.claim.closed.text: 連接未獲核准，可再試一次。
web.claim.closed.source: The connection wasn’t approved. You can try again.

web.claim.connected.text: {server} 已連接 Portico Account，正在取得安全連線，會自行完成設定。
web.claim.connected.source: {server} is connected to your Portico Account. It is getting its secure connection now and finishes setting up on its own.

web.claim.denied.text: 已拒絕，{server} 未連接，可關閉此視窗。
web.claim.denied.source: You declined. {server} isn’t connected. You can close this window.

web.claim.errorInvalid.text: 此連接要求無效，請從伺服器重新開始。
web.claim.errorInvalid.source: That connection request wasn’t valid. Start again from the server.

web.claim.errorStale.text: 此連接要求已回覆或過期，請重新開始。
web.claim.errorStale.source: That connection request was already answered or has expired. Start again.

web.claim.errorTooMany.text: 此伺服器已有三個等待中的連接要求，請核准或拒絕其一，或等待 10 分鐘讓其過期。
web.claim.errorTooMany.source: This server already has three connection requests waiting. Approve or deny one, or wait 10 minutes for them to expire.

web.claim.errorUnavailable.text: 此伺服器目前無法連接，請稍後再試。
web.claim.errorUnavailable.source: This server can’t be connected right now. Try again in a moment.

web.claim.expired.text: 此連接要求已過期或已回覆，請從伺服器重新開始。
web.claim.expired.source: This connection request has expired or was already answered. Start again from the server.

web.claim.lede.text: 連接後，他人可以 Portico Account 登入、在外地連接此伺服器並安全連接，伺服器會自行取得憑證。
web.claim.lede.source: Connecting lets people sign in with their Portico Account, reach this server away from home and connect to it securely. The server gets its certificate by itself.

web.claim.notFound.text: 此連接要求不屬於你的 Portico Account 或已不存在，請確認登入正確的帳號，或從伺服器重新開始。
web.claim.notFound.source: This connection request isn’t for your Portico Account, or it no longer exists. Check you’re signed in to the right account, or start again from the server.

web.claim.openFromServer.text: 請從伺服器開啟此頁：首次設定，或「設定」›「遠端存取」›「安全連線」。
web.claim.openFromServer.source: Open this page from your server: its first-run setup, or Settings › Remote access › Secure connection.

web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.text: 擁有並可管理伺服器的個人檔案。
web.claim.ownerProfileHelp.source: The profile that owns the server and can manage it.

web.claim.signInFirst.text: 請登入將擁有此伺服器的 Portico Account。
web.claim.signInFirst.source: Sign in to the Portico Account that will own this server.

web.claim.waiting.text: 請在 Portico Account 視窗中核准連接，完成後此頁會更新。
web.claim.waiting.source: Approve the connection in the Portico Account window. This page updates when you do.

web.connection.mismatchBody.text: {server} 的位址目前由其他裝置回應，因此此頁已暫停，Portico 會持續嘗試連接伺服器並於回應後恢復頁面。設定、帳號與切換伺服器仍可使用。
web.connection.mismatchBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}, so this page is paused. Portico keeps trying to reach your server and brings the page back when it answers. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.reconnectingBody.text: {server} 目前沒有回應，Portico 會持續嘗試並於重新連線後開啟。設定、帳號與切換伺服器仍可使用。
web.connection.reconnectingBody.source: {server} isn’t answering right now. Portico keeps trying and opens it as soon as it reconnects. Settings, your account and switching servers still work.

web.connection.replacedBody.text: {server} 的位址目前由其他裝置回應，Portico 會繼續嘗試連接伺服器。若伺服器已重新設定，請選擇「使用其他帳號或伺服器」並重新登入。
web.connection.replacedBody.source: Something else is answering at the address of {server}. Portico keeps trying to reach your server. If it was set up again from scratch, choose “Use another account or server” and sign in to it.

web.connection.replacedTitle.text: 另一部伺服器正在回應

web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.text: 檔案不是相符的 PEM 憑證與金鑰。
web.connectivity.customCertInvalid.source: The files aren’t a matching PEM certificate and key.

web.connectivity.customCertMismatch.source: The certificate doesn’t cover this domain.

web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.text: 無法讀取憑證或金鑰檔，請檢查路徑與伺服器讀取權限。
web.connectivity.customCertUnreadable.source: The certificate or key file can’t be read. Check the paths and that the server can read them.

web.connectivity.discovery.text: 在住家網路尋找此伺服器
web.connectivity.discovery.source: Find this server on the home network

web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.text: 此連線在住家網路外使用 HTTP。
web.connectivity.httpOutsideHome.source: This connection uses HTTP outside your home networks.

web.connectivity.interfaceHelp.text: 住家網路應用程式使用的網路介面，自動會略過容器與虛擬網路。
web.connectivity.interfaceHelp.source: Which network interface apps on your home network use. Automatic skips container and virtual networks.

web.connectivity.outsideLede.text: 非住家網路裝置的規則。
web.connectivity.outsideLede.source: Rules for devices that are not on your home network.

web.connectivity.pausedLimit.text: 暫停的影片多久後結束

web.connectivity.pausedLimitHelp.text: 將串流釋出給他人，觀看者可從上次位置繼續，音樂、有聲書與直播電視永不結束。
web.connectivity.pausedLimitHelp.source: Frees the stream for someone else. The viewer can pick up where they left off. Music, audiobooks and Live TV are never ended.

web.connectivity.whoMaySignIn.source: Who may sign in from outside

web.console.jobFailed.text: 此工作未能完成，詳細資料請見記錄。
web.console.jobFailed.source: This job didn’t finish. Logs has the details.

web.console.nav.channelsLede.text: 從媒體庫產生的全天候頻道。
web.console.nav.channelsLede.source: Always-on channels generated from your libraries.

web.console.nav.feedbackLede.text: 觀看者從應用程式回報的問題。
web.console.nav.feedbackLede.source: Problems viewers reported from their apps.

web.console.nav.librariesLede.text: 伺服器所知的內容及其來源。
web.console.nav.librariesLede.source: What the server knows about and where it comes from.

web.console.nav.storageLede.text: 連接至此伺服器的遠端儲存空間。
web.console.nav.storageLede.source: Remote storage attached to this server.

web.console.ownerBody.text: 請擁有者分享所需的內容，或以擁有者帳號登入。
web.console.ownerBody.source: Ask the owner to share what you need, or sign in with the owner account.

web.console.ownerTitle.text: 僅伺服器擁有者可管理此伺服器
web.console.ownerTitle.source: Only the server owner can manage this server

web.continue.failed.text: 無法將「{title}」從繼續觀看中移除，請再試一次。
web.continue.failed.source: “{title}” couldn’t be removed from Continue Watching. Try again.

web.continue.removed.text: 已將「{title}」從繼續觀看中移除。

web.continue.undoFailed.text: 無法將「{title}」放回繼續觀看，請播放以從上次位置繼續。
web.continue.undoFailed.source: “{title}” couldn’t be put back on Continue Watching. Play it to pick up where you left off.

web.custody.body.text: 現為 {server} 的擁有者，請接受以讓 Portico Account 持有其註冊，涵蓋遠端存取與邀請。
web.custody.body.source: You’re the owner of {server} now. Accept so your Portico Account holds its registration, which covers remote access and invitations.

web.custody.done.text: 現已持有 {server} 的 Portico 註冊。

web.custody.title.text: 接受此伺服器 Portico 註冊的所有權
web.custody.title.source: Accept ownership of this server’s Portico registration

web.deleteAccount.cannot.text: 此帳號目前無法刪除，請稍後再試。
web.deleteAccount.cannot.source: This account can’t be deleted right now. Try again later.

web.deleteAccount.checking.text: 正在檢查將刪除的內容

web.deleteAccount.confirmTitle.text: 要刪除 Portico Account 嗎？

web.deleteAccount.doneBody.text: 已登出 Portico Account，所在的伺服器會被通知移除你的資料。
web.deleteAccount.doneBody.source: You’re signed out of your Portico Account. Servers you were on are told to remove your data.

web.deleteAccount.help.text: 會移除帳號、其個人檔案，以及在其中所有伺服器的存取權，無法復原。
web.deleteAccount.help.source: Removes your account, its profiles and your access to every server on it. This can’t be undone.

web.deleteAccount.member.text: {count, plural, other {將失去 # 部受邀伺服器的存取權。}}
web.deleteAccount.member.source: {count, plural, one {You lose access to # server you were invited to.} other {You lose access to # servers you were invited to.}}

web.deleteAccount.mismatch.text: 內容不符，請依顯示完整輸入 {value}。
web.deleteAccount.mismatch.source: That doesn’t match. Type {value} exactly as shown.

web.deleteAccount.owned.text: {count, plural, other {擁有 # 部伺服器（{servers}），將離開帳號，其個人資料會被刪除。}}
web.deleteAccount.owned.source: {count, plural, one {You own {servers}. It leaves your account, and its personal data is deleted.} other {You own # servers ({servers}). They leave your account, and their personal data is deleted.}}

web.deleteAccount.profiles.text: {count, plural, other {你的 # 個個人檔案會被刪除。}}
web.deleteAccount.profiles.source: {count, plural, one {Your profile is deleted.} other {Your # profiles are deleted.}}

web.device.approveWarn.text: 僅在這些詳細資料與眼前的裝置相符時核准，將以你的身分登入。
web.device.approveWarn.source: Approve only if these details match the device in front of you. It will be signed in as you.

web.device.deniedBody.text: {server} 的擁有者已拒絕此瀏覽器，請其於「伺服器」›「存取」中允許後再檢查一次。
web.device.deniedBody.source: The owner of {server} has refused this browser. Ask them to allow it under Server › Access, then check again.

web.device.deniedTitle.text: 擁有者已拒絕此瀏覽器
web.device.deniedTitle.source: The owner turned this browser away

web.device.lede.text: 輸入電視上顯示的代碼以登入電視。
web.device.lede.source: Type the code shown on the TV to sign it in.

web.device.notFound.text: 找不到該代碼，請檢查電視後再試一次。
web.device.notFound.source: That code wasn’t found. Check it on the TV and try again.

web.device.signIn.text: 登入 Portico Account 以登入電視。
web.device.signIn.source: Sign in to your Portico Account to sign the TV in.

web.device.timeoutKept.source: The request timed out. Your code is kept.

web.devices.approvalBody.text: 此裝置已登入，但在你核准前無法瀏覽或播放。
web.devices.approvalBody.source: This device signed in but can’t browse or play until you approve it.

web.devices.everywhereBody.text: 所有裝置（包括這台）都會登出此伺服器，裝置上已有的下載項目會保留至下次連接。
web.devices.everywhereBody.source: Every device, including this one, is signed out of this server. Downloads already on a device stay until it next connects.

web.devices.trustedHelp.text: 此裝置下次登入時略過核准。
web.devices.trustedHelp.source: Skips approval the next time this device signs in.

web.diagnostics.clientReportBudget.text: 已達每日用戶端記錄上限。
web.diagnostics.clientReportBudget.source: The daily client log limit has been reached.

web.diagnostics.clientReportDevice.text: 請在此裝置登入以上傳記錄。
web.diagnostics.clientReportDevice.source: Sign in on this device to upload logs.

web.direct.back.text: 返回 Portico Account 登入

web.direct.codeLede.text: 此帳號已開啟兩步驟驗證，請輸入驗證器應用程式的代碼或備用碼。
web.direct.codeLede.source: Two-step verification is on for this account. Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

web.direct.lede.text: 使用存在於伺服器的帳號，僅在此瀏覽器與該伺服器之間使用。
web.direct.lede.source: Use an account that lives on your server. It stays between this browser and that server.

web.direct.ledeBundled.text: 使用存在於 {host} 的帳號。
web.direct.ledeBundled.source: Use an account that lives on {host}.

web.direct.newPasswordLede.text: 伺服器擁有者要求在繼續前選擇新密碼。
web.direct.newPasswordLede.source: The server’s owner asked you to choose a new password before you continue.

web.direct.recoveryHelp.text: 忘記此密碼嗎？請在伺服器的電腦上執行 portico-server recover-owner。
web.direct.recoveryHelp.source: Forgot this password? On the server’s computer, run portico-server recover-owner.

web.direct.recoveryLede.text: Portico Account 無法連接時，使用儲存在此伺服器上的擁有者帳號。
web.direct.recoveryLede.source: Use the owner account stored on this server when Portico Accounts can’t be reached.

web.direct.rememberProfile.text: 在此瀏覽器分頁記住此個人檔案
web.direct.rememberProfile.source: Remember this profile in this browser tab

web.directJoin.body.text: 已獲邀加入 {server}，請選擇使用者名稱與密碼以建立帳號。
web.directJoin.body.source: You’ve been invited to {server}. Choose a username and password to create your account.

web.metadataSource.onlineDescription.mov.source: Matches films with TMDB for titles, artwork, cast and ratings. Your own files and NFO details are used first.

web.metadataSource.onlineDescription.mus.source: Matches albums with MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive for details and artwork. Embedded tags are used first.

web.metadataSource.onlineDescription.tv.text: 透過一個線上提供者比對影集的標題、單集、圖片和評分：除非你選擇 TheTVDB，否則使用 TMDB。會先使用你自己的檔案和 NFO 詳細資料。

web.signIn.error.accountUnreachable.source: Portico can’t reach Portico Accounts. Check your internet connection, then try again.

web.signIn.error.address.text: Portico 無法使用此伺服器位址，請檢查後再試一次，通常形如 192.168.1.20:32500。
web.signIn.error.address.source: That isn’t a server address Portico can use. Check it and try again. It usually looks like 192.168.1.20:32500.

web.signIn.error.bug.text: Portico 無法完成在 {server} 的登入，請重新載入頁面後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.bug.source: Portico couldn’t finish signing you in to {server}. Reload the page and try again.

web.signIn.error.busy.text: {server} 正在為他人辦理登入，請稍後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.busy.source: {server} is busy signing people in. Try again in a moment.

web.signIn.error.changed.text: 登入期間 {server} 已有變更，請再試一次。
web.signIn.error.changed.source: {server} changed while you were signing in. Try again.

web.signIn.error.clock.text: 此裝置與伺服器的時間不一致，請檢查此裝置的日期與時間後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.clock.source: This device and the server don’t agree on the time. Check the date and time on this device, then try again.

web.signIn.error.closed.text: {server} 不再接受新帳號，請向其擁有者索取邀請。
web.signIn.error.closed.source: {server} isn’t taking new accounts. Ask its owner for an invitation.

web.signIn.error.code.text: 此代碼無效，請輸入驗證器應用程式的目前代碼或備用碼。
web.signIn.error.code.source: That code didn’t work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

web.signIn.error.codeExpired.text: 此次登入耗時過久，{server} 已結束，請重新開始。
web.signIn.error.codeExpired.source: That sign-in took too long, so {server} ended it. Start again.

web.signIn.error.credentials.text: {server} 上沒有符合此使用者名稱與密碼的帳號，請檢查後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.credentials.source: That username and password didn’t match an account on {server}. Check them and try again.

web.signIn.error.currentPassword.text: {server} 不再接受登入時使用的密碼，請重新登入。
web.signIn.error.currentPassword.source: {server} no longer accepts the password you signed in with. Start the sign-in again.

web.signIn.error.details.text: 請輸入 {server} 的使用者名稱與密碼。
web.signIn.error.details.source: Enter your username and password for {server}.

web.signIn.error.deviceDenied.text: {server} 的擁有者已拒絕此瀏覽器，請其於「伺服器」›「存取」中允許後再登入。
web.signIn.error.deviceDenied.source: The owner of {server} has turned this browser away. Ask them to allow it under Server › Access, then sign in again.

web.signIn.error.forbidden.text: {server} 不允許此帳號進入，請擁有者於「伺服器」›「存取」中檢查存取權。
web.signIn.error.forbidden.source: {server} isn’t letting this account in. Ask its owner to check your access under Server › Access.

web.signIn.error.identity.text: Portico 無法確認已連接 {server}，因此在登入前停止，請檢查位址後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.identity.source: Portico couldn’t confirm that it reached {server}, so it stopped before signing in. Check the address and try again.

web.signIn.error.invitationExpired.text: 此邀請已過期，請向 {server} 的擁有者索取新的邀請。
web.signIn.error.invitationExpired.source: This invitation has expired. Ask the owner of {server} for a new one.

web.signIn.error.invitationIncomplete.text: 此邀請連結不完整，請開啟收到的訊息中的完整連結。
web.signIn.error.invitationIncomplete.source: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the whole link from the message you were sent.

web.signIn.error.invitationOtherAccount.text: 此邀請是為其他 Portico Account 建立的，請以該帳號登入，或向 {server} 的擁有者索取新的邀請。
web.signIn.error.invitationOtherAccount.source: This invitation was made for a different Portico Account. Sign in with that account, or ask the owner of {server} for a new one.

web.signIn.error.invitationUsed.text: 此邀請已被使用或撤回，請向 {server} 的擁有者索取新的邀請。
web.signIn.error.invitationUsed.source: This invitation has already been used or was withdrawn. Ask the owner of {server} for a new one.

web.signIn.error.newPassword.text: {server} 未接受此密碼，請選擇更長且更難猜測的密碼。
web.signIn.error.newPassword.source: {server} didn’t accept that password. Choose a longer one that’s harder to guess.

web.signIn.error.notPortico.text: 該位址有回應，但不是 Portico 伺服器，請檢查位址後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.notPortico.source: That address answered, but not as a Portico server. Check the address and try again.

web.signIn.error.notSetUp.text: 此伺服器尚未設定，請在與伺服器相同網路的瀏覽器中開啟其位址以完成設定。
web.signIn.error.notSetUp.source: This server isn’t set up yet. Open its address in a browser on the same network as the server to set it up.

web.signIn.error.offline.text: 此裝置已離線，無法連接 {server}，請連接網際網路後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.offline.source: This device is offline, so it can’t reach {server}. Connect to the internet, then try again.

web.signIn.error.origin.text: {server} 不接受從此頁面登入，請從常用位址開啟 Portico。
web.signIn.error.origin.source: {server} doesn’t accept sign-ins from this page. Open Portico from its usual address.

web.signIn.error.outsideHours.text: {server} 在此時段不允許此帳號進入，請稍後再試。
web.signIn.error.outsideHours.source: {server} doesn’t let this account in at this time of day. Try again later.

web.signIn.error.pinFormat.text: 個人檔案 PIN 碼為四位數字。
web.signIn.error.pinFormat.source: A profile PIN is four digits.

web.signIn.error.pinRequired.text: 請輸入此個人檔案的 PIN 碼。

web.signIn.error.porticoRejected.text: {server} 未接受你的 Portico Account，請再試一次，若持續發生，請擁有者確認伺服器已連接 Portico。
web.signIn.error.porticoRejected.source: {server} didn’t accept your Portico Account. Try again; if it keeps happening, ask its owner to check that the server is connected to Portico.

web.signIn.error.profilesChanged.text: {server} 上的個人檔案已有變更，請重新選擇。
web.signIn.error.profilesChanged.source: The profiles on {server} changed. Choose again.

web.signIn.error.reload.text: 此頁已過期，請重新載入後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.reload.source: This page is out of date. Reload it, then try again.

web.signIn.error.remoteNotAllowed.text: {server} 僅允許此帳號從住家網路登入。
web.signIn.error.remoteNotAllowed.source: {server} only lets this account sign in from its home network.

web.signIn.error.serverFault.text: {server} 在登入時發生問題，請再試一次，若持續發生，擁有者可檢查伺服器記錄。
web.signIn.error.serverFault.source: {server} ran into a problem while signing you in. Try again; if it keeps happening, its owner can check the server’s log.

web.signIn.error.serverFull.text: {server} 磁碟空間不足，無法讓任何人登入，請擁有者釋出空間。
web.signIn.error.serverFull.source: {server} has run out of disk space, so it can’t sign anyone in. Ask its owner to free some space.

web.signIn.error.serverOld.text: {server} 需要更新後此次登入才能運作，請擁有者更新。
web.signIn.error.serverOld.source: {server} needs an update before this sign-in works. Ask its owner to update it.

web.signIn.error.signOutPending.text: Portico 仍在完成登出其他 Portico Account，請檢查連線後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.signOutPending.source: Portico is still finishing signing out another Portico Account. Check your connection, then try again.

web.signIn.error.startAgain.source: {server} needs you to start the sign-in again.

web.signIn.error.storage.text: 此瀏覽器無法安全保存登入狀態，請離開私密瀏覽或更新瀏覽器後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.storage.source: This browser can’t keep sign-ins safely. Leave private browsing or update the browser, then try again.

web.signIn.error.timeout.text: {server} 回應逾時，請稍後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.timeout.source: {server} took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.

web.signIn.error.tooMany.text: 登入嘗試次數過多，請一分鐘後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.tooMany.source: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

web.signIn.error.tooManySeconds.text: 登入嘗試次數過多，請在 {seconds, plural, other {# 秒}}後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.tooManySeconds.source: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

web.signIn.error.unreachable.text: Portico 無法連接 {server}，請確認已開機並連線後再試一次。
web.signIn.error.unreachable.source: Portico can’t reach {server}. Check that it’s on and connected, then try again.

web.signIn.error.unreadable.text: {server} 的回應是此版本 Portico 無法讀取的形式，擁有者可能需要更新。
web.signIn.error.unreadable.source: {server} answered in a way this version of Portico can’t read. Its owner may need to update it.

web.signIn.error.update.text: 此 Portico 版本過舊，不適用於 {server}，請重新載入頁面以取得最新版本後再登入。
web.signIn.error.update.source: This copy of Portico is too old for {server}. Reload the page to get the latest one, then sign in again.

web.signIn.error.usernameTaken.text: {server} 上已有此使用者名稱，請選擇其他名稱。
web.signIn.error.usernameTaken.source: That username is already taken on {server}. Choose another.

web.signin.accountLede.text: 使用 Portico Account 登入，以存取與你分享的伺服器。
web.signin.accountLede.source: Sign in with your Portico Account to access servers shared with you.

web.signin.hostedLede.text: 此伺服器使用 Portico Account，請至 web.getportico.tv 登入，會帶你返回媒體庫。
web.signin.hostedLede.source: This server uses Portico Accounts. Sign in at web.getportico.tv and it will bring you back to your libraries.

web.storage.davAmbiguous.text: 遠端來源變更可能尚未完成。
web.storage.davAmbiguous.source: A remote source change may not have completed.

web.storage.davPasswordKept.text: 密碼儲存在伺服器上且不再顯示。
web.storage.davPasswordKept.source: The password is stored on the server and never shown again.

web.storage.emptyHelp.text: 連接 WebDAV 分享或 rclone 遠端以使用別處的媒體，本機資料夾請於「媒體庫」新增。
web.storage.emptyHelp.source: Attach a WebDAV share or an rclone remote to use media stored elsewhere. Local folders are added under Libraries.

web.storage.insecureLocal.text: 允許區域網路上未加密（http）位址
web.storage.insecureLocal.source: Allow an unencrypted (http) address on the local network

web.storage.insecureLocalHelp.text: 僅適用於不出住家網路的分享。
web.storage.insecureLocalHelp.source: Only for shares that never leave your home network.

web.storage.keepSavedPassword.text: 留空以保留儲存的密碼。
web.storage.keepSavedPassword.source: Leave empty to keep the saved password.

web.storage.libraryFolders.text: 來源掛載且健康後，遠端儲存空間上的媒體庫資料夾可於「媒體庫」新增。
web.storage.libraryFolders.source: Library folders on remote storage are added under Libraries once the source is mounted and healthy.

web.storage.mountAmbiguous.text: 儲存空間變更可能尚未完成，再次變更前請先檢查其結果。
web.storage.mountAmbiguous.source: A storage change may not have completed. Check its result before making another change.

web.storage.rcloneBinary.text: 伺服器上的 rclone 執行檔

web.storage.rcloneConfigHelp.text: 貼上一次並儲存在伺服器上，其中的密鑰不再顯示。
web.storage.rcloneConfigHelp.source: Pasted once and stored on the server. Secrets inside are never shown again.

web.storage.rcloneLede.text: Portico 會在私有沙箱中執行 rclone 並掛載遠端供媒體庫使用。
web.storage.rcloneLede.source: Portico runs your rclone binary in a private sandbox and mounts the remote for libraries to use.

web.storage.rcloneRemoteHelp.text: rclone 設定中的遠端名稱，可加路徑。
web.storage.rcloneRemoteHelp.source: The remote name from your rclone config, with an optional path.

web.storage.removeMountBody.text: 會停止掛載並移除儲存的設定，使用它的媒體庫會失去這些檔案的存取權，遠端內容不會刪除。
web.storage.removeMountBody.source: The mount is stopped and its saved configuration removed. Libraries using it lose access to those files; nothing on the remote is deleted.

web.storage.removeSourceBody.text: 會移除儲存的連線與密碼，分享上的內容不會刪除。
web.storage.removeSourceBody.source: The saved connection and its password are removed. Nothing on the share is deleted.

web.storage.webdavKeepConnection.text: 留空以保留 {origin}，輸入新位址後僅使用此處輸入的內容。
web.storage.webdavKeepConnection.source: Leave empty to keep {origin}. A new address uses only what you type here.

web.telemetry.noViewing.source: Nothing was watched in this period.

web.together.blockedOne.text: {names} 看不到其中一個項目，請移除或仍要播放（其將略過）。
web.together.blockedOne.source: {names} can’t see one of these. Remove it, or play anyway and they’ll sit it out.

web.together.blockedSome.text: {names} 看不到其中部分項目，請移除或仍要播放（其將略過）。
web.together.blockedSome.source: {names} can’t see some of these. Remove them, or play anyway and they’ll sit them out.

web.together.codeHelp.text: 產生可讀出或傳送的短代碼，有效期 15 分鐘。
web.together.codeHelp.source: Make a short code to read out or send. It works for 15 minutes.

web.together.emptyQueueHold.text: 長按標題並選擇「加入群組佇列」。
web.together.emptyQueueHold.source: Hold a title and choose Add to group queue.

web.together.emptyQueueHost.text: 尚未排定，請從標題選單以「加入群組佇列」新增。
web.together.emptyQueueHost.source: Nothing queued. Add titles from their menu with Add to group queue.

web.together.ended.away.text: 主持人離開過久，群組已結束。
web.together.ended.away.source: The host was away too long, so the group ended.

web.together.endsIn.text: 除非其返回，否則群組將在 {time} 後結束。
web.together.endsIn.source: The group ends in {time} unless they return.

web.together.eyebrowFallback.text: 與此伺服器上的其他人同步
web.together.eyebrowFallback.source: In step with other people on this server

web.together.hiddenEntry.text: 有人新增了此個人檔案看不到的標題
web.together.hiddenEntry.source: Someone added a title this profile can’t see

web.together.hiddenTitle.text: 此個人檔案看不到的內容
web.together.hiddenTitle.source: Something you can’t see on this profile

web.together.hostPicks.text: 由主持人選擇觀看內容。
web.together.hostPicks.source: The host picks what to watch.

web.together.inviteHelp.text: {count, plural, other {對方選擇「同看」後輸入代碼，於 {time} 前可使用 # 次。}}須為此伺服器的個人檔案。
web.together.inviteHelp.source: {count, plural, one {They choose Watch Together, then enter the code. Works once until {time}.} other {They choose Watch Together, then enter the code. Works # times until {time}.}} They need a profile on this server.

web.together.inviteHelpJoin.text: 對方開啟「同看」並以此代碼加入，於 {time} 前可使用 {uses} 次，須為此伺服器的個人檔案。
web.together.inviteHelpJoin.source: They open Watch Together and join with this code. It works {uses} times until {time}, for people with a profile on this server.

web.together.joinHelp.text: 請向主持人索取八位元代碼。
web.together.joinHelp.source: Ask the host for the eight-character code.

web.together.pausesIn.text: 除非其返回，否則群組將在 {time} 後暫停。
web.together.pausesIn.source: The group pauses in {time} unless they return.

web.together.pendingTitle.source: {title} will play as soon as your group starts.

web.together.pickHelp.text: 開啟任何標題的選單並選擇「與群組一起觀看」。
web.together.pickHelp.source: Open any title’s menu and choose Watch with group.

web.together.pickHelpHold.text: 長按任何標題並選擇「與群組一起觀看」。
web.together.pickHelpHold.source: Hold any title and choose Watch with group.

web.together.pill.label.text: {name}：{count, plural, other {# 人}}觀看中，{status}。查看在場者
web.together.pill.label.source: {name}: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} watching, {status}. Show who’s here

web.together.pill.people.source: {count, plural, one {# person watching} other {# people watching}}

web.together.reconnecting.text: 正在重新連接群組，恢復後即會同步。
web.together.reconnecting.source: Reconnecting to the group. You’ll be back in step as soon as it’s back.

web.together.reconnectingApple.text: 正在重新連接群組，恢復後即會同步。
web.together.reconnectingApple.source: Reconnecting to the group. You’ll be back in step as soon as it returns.

web.together.refused.text: 群組中有人在其個人檔案看不到此標題。
web.together.refused.source: Someone in the group can’t see this title on their profile.

web.together.shareMessage.text: 以代碼 {code} 加入我的 Portico 群組
web.together.shareMessage.source: Join my Portico group with the code {code}

web.together.startHelp.text: 會取得可分享的代碼，再從任何標題的選單選擇「與群組一起觀看」。
web.together.startHelp.source: You get a code to share. Then choose Watch with group from any title’s menu.

web.together.subtitle.text: 與此伺服器上的人同步觀看，所有人看到相同進度，由主持人保持同步。
web.together.subtitle.source: Watch in sync with people on this server. Everyone sees the same moment, and the host keeps you together.

web.together.tagline.text: 與此伺服器上的朋友同步觀看
web.together.tagline.source: Watch in step with friends on this server

web.together.taglineBody.text: 群組中的每個人各自在自己的螢幕上一起播放、暫停與跳過。
web.together.taglineBody.source: Everyone in the group plays, pauses and skips together, each on their own screen.

web.together.takeOver.source: You can take over as host.

web.together.waiting.text: {total} 中的 {ready} 人已就緒・{count, plural, other {等待 # 人}}
web.together.waiting.source: {ready} of {total} ready · {count, plural, one {waiting for one person} other {waiting for # people}}

web.together.whoControls.text: 誰可播放、暫停與選擇內容
web.together.whoControls.source: Who can play, pause and choose what’s on

web.transcoding.allowTranscodingHelp.text: 裝置無法播放檔案時，伺服器會轉檔，關閉後這些裝置會顯示錯誤。
web.transcoding.allowTranscodingHelp.source: When a device can’t play a file, the server converts it. If you turn this off, those devices show an error instead.

web.transcoding.capacityLede.source: Leave a field empty for no limit.

web.transcoding.conversionLede.text: 裝置無法直接播放檔案時，伺服器可即時轉檔。
web.transcoding.conversionLede.source: When a device cannot play a file as it is, the server can convert it on the fly.

web.transcoding.ownerOnly.text: 僅擁有者可查看傳送狀態。
web.transcoding.ownerOnly.source: Only the owner can see delivery status.

web.transcoding.serverCapHelp.text: 此伺服器所有使用者合計。

web.twoStep.cantScan.text: 無法掃描？請輸入此金鑰：

web.twoStep.recommended.text: 若此伺服器可從網際網路連接，建議開啟。
web.twoStep.recommended.source: Recommended if this server is reachable from the internet.

web.twoStep.scanBody.text: 再輸入其顯示的 6 位數代碼。
web.twoStep.scanBody.source: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

web.twoStep.scanTitle.text: 用驗證器應用程式掃描

web.verify.changed.text: 電子郵件已變更，請重新登入。

web.verify.confirmedElsewhere.text: 電子郵件已確認，請返回開始的裝置。
web.verify.confirmedElsewhere.source: Email confirmed. Go back to the device where you started.

web.verify.expired.text: 此連結已過期或已使用，請向 Portico 申請新代碼。
web.verify.expired.source: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new code from Portico.
